tool.name: Collection element labels
tool.description: one dataset per element, holding that element's identifier

param.name: input
param.label: Collection to label
param.help: Map this over a collection. Each job writes its element's identifier to a one-line dataset, so the output is a parallel collection carrying the names as DATA.

tool.help:
**Collection element labels** — turn element identifiers into data.
Galaxy cannot route a collection element identifier into a text parameter. Connect a collection to one and you get the internal representation of the element object rather than its name — which is how every fold in WF-I's 2026-06-13 runs died.
The workaround is to carry the name as a dataset. Map this tool over a collection and each job writes its own element identifier to a one-line file, giving a parallel collection whose contents are the names. A downstream tool then reads the name from the file.
That is what `multiz_fold`'s `hinge_label` input expects, and this replaces the hand-built `hinge_names` collection that previously had to be uploaded.
